attempts.summary: Configured sudo command logging on node1 via /etc/sudoers.d/sudo-commands-log (Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log", log_year, !syslog). Every sudo invocation now records user, timestamp, PWD and COMMAND to the dedicated log file, and is no longer written to the general system log (/var/log/secure or journald). Verified before and after a full node reboot (boot_id changed, confirming an actual restart), including that the config persisted and post-restart sudo activity was captured correctly in the new log and absent from the general log.
